'''Wolfgang Rautenberg''' (27 February 1936 − 4 September 2011) was a German mathematician and [[logician]] whose areas of research were [[model theory]], [[non-classical logic]], [[modal logic]], [[temporal logic]] and [[self reference]].

==Life==
Rautenberg was born in [[Potsdam]]. He graduated with an [[abitur]] from the [[Gymnasium (Germany)|gymnasium]] in [[Ludwigslust]]. He studied mathematics and [[physics]] at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin|Humboldt University]] in East Berlin ([[East Germany|GDR]]), and there in 1963 Rautenberg received a doctorate and worked as a logician.<ref>Forschung an der FU Berlin, FB Mathematik (1990), pp. 57–58.</ref><ref name="Schuder">W. Schuder (1983), p. 3298.</ref> In 1968 Rautenberg graduated from the Humboldt University as an academic lecturer.<ref name="Schuder" /> From 1969 to 1973 Rautenberg was [[docent]] at the Humboldt University.<ref name="Schuder" /><ref>K. Gödel (2003), pp. 179–183.</ref> Because the [[Stasi]] contacted him to force him into co-operation, Rautenberg left East Germany in 1973 and in 1974 became Professor in [[West Germany]].<ref name="Schuder" /> In 1976 he accepted a call to chair the [[academic department]]<ref name="Schuder" /> for [[mathematical logic]] and [[foundations of mathematics]] at [[Free University of Berlin|Freie Universität Berlin]].

Wolfgang Rautenberg was also a very active contributor in the [[HP 48 series|HP48]] and [[HP 49/50 series#49G|HP49G / HP49G+]] calculator community,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/comp.sys.hp48/Wolfgang$20Rautenberg%7Csort:relevance|title=Google USENET archive search results|website=groups.google.com|access-date=April 4, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://page.mi.fu-berlin.de/~raut/WR49/index.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040804224203/http://page.mi.fu-berlin.de/~raut/WR49/index.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 4, 2004|title=Prof. Rautenberg's HP49G Tools|website=page.mi.fu-berlin.de|access-date=April 6, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://page.mi.fu-berlin.de/~raut/index.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040710065137/http://page.mi.fu-berlin.de/~raut/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=July 10, 2004|title=Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Rautenberg|website=page.mi.fu-berlin.de|access-date=April 6, 2020}}</ref> with many important contributions.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hpcalc.org/search.php?query=rautenberg&title=1&description=1&author=1&comments=1&zip=1&library=1|title=Hpcalc.org search results|website=www.hpcalc.org|access-date=April 4, 2020}}</ref>
